_notes.purpose: Single-source rig calibration file for DESK-CORE (ElRobot 7-DoF + gripper, fixed topdown cam, follower wrist cam).
_notes.status_hint: Generated by scripts/export_rig_calib.py; rerun it instead of editing calibrated values by hand.
_notes.units: meters and radians; joint ticks are ST3215 12-bit [0..4095].

frames.camera_frame: OpenCV optical frame (+X right, +Y down, +Z forward out of lens)
frames.transform_convention: T_A_B is 4x4 row-major mapping points in frame B into frame A (p_A = T_A_B @ p_B). For wrist cam: T_world_cam_wrist(q) = T_world_ee(q) @ T_ee_cam_wrist.

required_for_3d_and_ik.T_world_cam_top: REQUIRED for metric depth & 3D pixel_to_world from top camera: 4x4 transform from top optical frame -> ElRobot base_link (meters).
required_for_3d_and_ik.z_table: REQUIRED for ray-plane projection: tabletop height (meters) in ElRobot base_link frame.
required_for_3d_and_ik.H_table: OPTIONAL (or REQUIRED if skipping T_world_cam_top): 3x3 4-corner homography mapping top pixels -> tabletop (X, Y) at z_table.
required_for_3d_and_ik.T_ee_cam_wrist: REQUIRED for eye-in-hand 3D depth/projection: 4x4 fixed transform from wrist optical frame -> Gripper_Base_v1_1.
required_for_3d_and_ik.joint_zero_ticks: REQUIRED for real arm motion: ST3215 ticks {'1':..,'7':..} matching ElRobot URDF zero pose (defaults to range midpoint if omitted).
required_for_3d_and_ik.joint_signs: REQUIRED if any servo direction is inverted vs URDF: {'1': +/-1, ..., '7': +/-1} (defaults to +1).

_notes.valid_while: Station motor ranges (station_data) and servo offsets are unchanged, the wrist camera mount is untouched, the scene camera is not moved, and streams run at the intrinsics' image size (1280x720).
